scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wangxueban/contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w shenwang-bff" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wangxueban/contracts && npm run build -w shenwang-bff && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wangxueban/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint -w web && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/server/src packages/contracts/src tests/e2e scripts playwright.config.ts
